titulo.alumno:
«Подтекст и осторожный вывод»
Subtext and a cautious conclusion

intro: An inference must rest on clues in the text and be expressed with the appropriate degree of certainty: вероятно, возможно, трудно утверждать.

piezas.titulo: An inference must rest on clues in the text and be expressed with the appropriate degree of certainty: вероятно, возможно, трудно утверждать.
texto: An inference must rest on clues in the text and be expressed with the appropriate degree of certainty: вероятно, возможно, трудно утверждать.
Distinguish what is explicit from what is probable, and avoid presenting a plausible interpretation as a literal fact.

frases.estudio: Организаторы не подтвердили перенос, однако уже изменили расписание на сайте.
frases.alumno: The organisers did not confirm the postponement, although they have already changed the timetable on the website.

frases.estudio: Можно предположить, что решение ещё не объявили официально.
frases.alumno: It can be assumed that the decision has not yet been officially announced.

pregunta.texto: What can be inferred with caution?

opciones.texto: The timetable changed, but official confirmation is missing
opciones.explicacion: The text mentions a change and the absence of confirmation.
